name: Yakult Honsha Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yakult Honsha Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells food and beverage products in Japan, the Americas, Asia, Oceania, and Europe. The company operates through Food and Beverages (Japan), Food and Beverages (The Americas), Food and Beverages (Asia and Oceania), Food and Beverages (Europe), and Others segments. It offers fermented milk drinks, energy drinks, yogurt, vegetable and fruit beverage, soy milk, health food, plant-derived ingredients, juices, noodles, etc. through its home delivery and retail store channels.
